items.name: aomi-theme
items.description: Shadcn-compatible theme variables (light + dark) for Aomi components.

items.name: agent-routing
items.description: Host-owned Auto and Direct routing contract for Aomi UI.

items.name: aomi-widget
items.description: Embeddable Aomi widget with tenant-scoped provider or wallet authentication.

items.name: aomi-frame
items.description: Full assistant shell with thread list and runtime wiring.

items.name: aomi-wallet-kit
items.description: Generic Aomi wallet kit context. Identity → UserState sync is mounted automatically by AomiWalletKitContextProvider.

items.name: control-bar
items.description: Control bar with model/App selectors, API key input, and wallet connect.

items.name: assistant-thread
items.description: Chat surface built on @assistant-ui primitives.

items.name: assistant-thread-list
items.description: Thread list wrapper wired to runtime adapter.

items.name: assistant-threadlist-sidebar
items.description: Sidebar shell for thread navigation and wallet footer slot.

items.name: assistant-tool-fallback
items.description: Fallback renderer for assistant tool calls.

items.name: attachment
items.description: Attachment renderer compatible with @assistant-ui/react 0.14.x.

items.name: notification
items.description: Notification toaster wired to the runtime notification store.

items.name: sonner
items.description: Shadcn wrapper for Sonner toasts.

items.name: activity-sidebar
items.description: Activity rail and wallet impact review for durable attended Actions.

items.name: aomi-para-provider
items.description: Para-backed Aomi wallet kit provider with the existing Aomi AA path.

items.name: aomi-privy-provider
items.description: Privy-backed Aomi wallet kit provider using Privy's hosted smart wallets (EVM 4337) and Privy's embedded Solana wallets. Bundler, paymaster, and AA implementation are configured in the integrator's Privy dashboard.

items.name: button
items.description: Displays a button or a component that looks like a button.

items.name: input
items.description: Displays a form input field or a component that looks like an input field.

items.name: label
items.description: Renders an accessible label associated with controls.

items.name: card
items.description: Displays a card with header, content, and footer.

items.name: badge
items.description: Displays a badge or a component that looks like a badge.

items.name: avatar
items.description: An image element with a fallback for representing the user.

items.name: skeleton
items.description: Use to show a placeholder while content is loading.

items.name: tooltip
items.description: A popup that displays information related to an element when the element receives keyboard focus or the mouse hovers over it.

items.name: separator
items.description: Visually or semantically separates content.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.description: Displays the path to the current resource using a hierarchy of links.

items.name: sidebar
items.description: Displays a sidebar navigation component.

items.name: dialog
items.description: A window overlaid on either the primary window or another dialog window.

items.name: sheet
items.description: Extends the Dialog component to display content that complements the main content of the screen.

items.name: collapsible
items.description: An interactive component which expands/collapses a panel.

items.name: command
items.description: Fast, composable, unstyled command menu for React.

items.name: popover
items.description: Displays rich content in a portal, triggered by a button.

items.name: alert
items.description: Displays a callout for user attention.

items.name: accordion
items.description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content.

items.name: drawer
items.description: A drawer component for mobile navigation menus and similar interfaces.
